| # clcan_fd_sendData {#clcan_fd_senddata-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Sends a message via CAN channel.

 

Remarks:

 

- Channel must be initialized with clcan_initxt() before using.

- Channel is not buffered until a buffer is registered with clcan_fd_registerTxBuffer() function.

- If a buffer is registered, messages are saved in the buffer and will be sent in a background process as fast as possible. The buffer principle is first in first out (FIFO).

 

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:1.2396in;height:0.4063in;border:none"}   •CAN Rx IDs: 18DA01FA/18DBFFFA and CAN Tx ID: 18DAFA01 shall not be used for CLAPI communication

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Parameter                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                   | |
| +===================================+===============================================================================================================================================================================+ |
| | Chnl_u8                           | Indicates the CAN channel.                                                                                                                                                    | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |   ------- -------- ---------------                                                                                                                                            | |
| |                                   |   Value   Define   Meaning                                                                                                                                                    | |
| |                                   |   0       CAN_1    CAN Channel 1                                                                                                                                              | |
| |                                   |   1       CAN_2    CAN Channel 2                                                                                                                                              | |
| |                                   |   2       CAN_3    CAN Channel 3                                                                                                                                              | |
| |                                   |   3       CAN_4    CAN Channel 4                                                                                                                                              | |
| |                                   |   ------- -------- ---------------                                                                                                                                            | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | id_u32                            | Identifier of CAN message.                                                                                                                                                    | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | Value range:                                                                                                                                                                  | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |           0x000 .. 0x7FF (11-bit standard format)                                                                                                                             | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |           0x00000000 .. 0x1FFFFFFF (29-bit extended format)                                                                                                                   | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | format_u8                         | Indicates the format of the CAN message.                                                                                                                                      | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | Possible values:                                                                                                                                                              | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | •CAN_STD_DU8 (0) - 11-bit standard format                                                                                                                                     | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | •CAN_EXD_DU8 (1) - 29-bit extended format                                                                                                                                     | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | •CAN_STD_FD_DU8(2) - 11-bit standard format                                                                                                                                   | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | •CAN_EXD_FD_DU8(3) - 29-bit extended format                                                                                                                                   | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | numBytes_u8                       | Number of bytes to be sent.                                                                                                                                                   | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                               | |
| |                                   | Value range: 0 .. 64                                                                                                                                                          | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | data_pau8                         | Pointer to array of data bytes. The number of bytes is contained in parameter numBytes_u8. A NULL pointer is allowed if number of data bytes (parameter numBytes_u8) is zero. | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Return Value          | Define                      | Description                                                               | |
| +=======================+=============================+===========================================================================+ |
| | 0                     | CLCAN_ERR_NO_ERRORS_DU16    | Function is called without errors. CAN message will be sent.              | |
| |                       |                             |                                                                           | |
| |                       |                             |                                                                           | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 4                     | CLCAN_ERR_PROTOCOL_DU16     | Protocol is invalid,This interface is not supporting on current protocol. | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 14                    | CLCAN_ERR_CHNL_DU16         | Unknown CAN channel.                                                      | |
| |                       |                             |                                                                           | |
| |                       |                             |                                                                           | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 15                    | CLCAN_ERR_ID_DU16           | Invalid identifier.                                                       | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 16                    | CLCAN_ERR_FORMAT_DU16       | Invalid format.                                                           | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 17                    | CLCAN_ERR_NUM_DATA_DU16     | Invalid number of data bytes.                                             | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 19                    | CLCAN_ERR_CHNL_INACTIV_DU16 | Channel Inactive                                                          | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 20                    | CLCAN_ERR_TXBUF_OVFL_DU16   | CAN message could not be sent, because of send buffer is full. \*1)       | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | 60                    | CLCAN_ERR_INVALID_ADDR_DU16 | Invalid address (parameter data_pau8).                                    | |
| +-----------------------+-----------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| \*1) possible reasons:                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| a\) CLAPI                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| •no can send buffer was registered or buffer registered is too small; see clcan_registerTxBuf()                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| •too many CAN messages have to be sent per time (more orders exceed performance of sending); use higher baudrate, see clcan_init()  |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| b\) external factors                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| •CAN bus is busy by CAN messages with higher priorities sending by other ECU\'s so that CAN messages of the own ECU cannot be sent. |
|                                                                                                                                     |
| •There is a bus error but nevertheless CAN messages will be sent (by own ECU).                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                     |
